<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="y8p-GQ6z6ft1YbIDzbrh"> <mxGraphModel dx="1720" dy="1209" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 actor Client
 participant Filter as JwtRequestFilter
 participant JS as JwtServiceImpl
 participant UDS as AppUserDetailsService
 participant SCH as SecurityContextHolder
 participant Ctrl as @PreAuthorize-protected Controller

 Client->>Filter: Request + \"Authorization: Bearer <token>\"
 Filter->>JS: extractUsername(token)
 Filter->>UDS: loadUserByUsername(username)
 UDS-->>Filter: UserDetails
 Filter->>JS: isTokenValid(token, userDetails)
 alt token valid
 Filter->>SCH: setAuthentication(UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken)
 Filter->>Ctrl: continue filter chain
 Ctrl->>Ctrl: @PreAuthorize role check (hasRole/hasAnyRole)
 Ctrl-->>Client: 200 OK / business response
 else token invalid / expired
 Filter->>Filter: HandlerExceptionResolver.resolveException()
 Filter-->>Client: 401 / 403
 end",
 "config": null
